title: Sandiganbayan rejects Revilla bid to dismiss P92-M flood control case

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Sandiganbayan Third Division has dismissed the bid of former Sen. Bong Revilla and his co-accused to dismiss the malversation case involving an alleged ghost flood control project in Bulacan worth more than P92 million. Third Division Clerk of Court Atty. Dennis Pulma shared the information on Wednesday. He said Revilla filed a motion for leave to file a demurrer to evidence on October 19.
